description: IOP Publishing's journal class, from IOP's template bundle (not on CTAN); one column, fixed layout. Its text block leaves a 12.7mm right margin for 25mm margin notes; as \articletype does in IOP's template (cls l.95), notes go to the 44mm left margin (\reversemarginpar). In two columns (\twocolumn) the kernel ignores it for a right column's notes, and note.notecolumn places its own column, so those still run off the paper until off-paper notes are judged (MN6).
